## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the problem and what this change makes possible. Link related issues, if any.

## Changes

Summarize the final implementation or documentation changes. Include a before/after example when useful.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. For code or rule changes, run `npm run check` and relevant CLI examples. For documentation-only changes, verify links and examples.

## Scope rules and uncertainty

For rule changes, link the official GitHub OAuth evidence, describe applicability conditions and alternatives, and explain how unknown cases are handled. Otherwise write "Not applicable."

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/sinzbtw/scopetrace/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/sinzbtw/scopetrace/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] This PR contains no real credentials, private source excerpts, or sensitive logs.
- [ ] Relevant behavior changes have regression tests, or this is documentation only.
- [ ] English and Russian READMEs are synchronized when affected.
- [ ] Rule/catalog and report-schema versions are updated when required.
